stem: Meera plants a seed in her school garden in Pune. When the seed germinates, she sees that it has two cotyledons. What type of leaf venation and root system should she expect this plant to have?

options.text: parallel venation and a fibrous root system
reticulate venation and a taproot system
parallel venation and a taproot system
reticulate venation and a fibrous root system

teacher.key_rationale: Two cotyledons means a dicotyledon; dicot plants have reticulate venation and a taproot system, so B is correct. Option A describes monocots (the sibling-term swap trap), while C and D mix the two feature sets.
